title: 외래어 2: 물건 — 컴퓨터, 텔레비전, 카메라 읽기
objective: You can read six common object loanwords and choose the right Korean spelling for English k, v and l.
summary: Read everyday object words borrowed from English, like 컴퓨터 and 카메라.

task.title: Read and choose words
task.line: Read each Korean word or sentence out loud first, then choose or write the answer.

words.exampleMeaning: I do my homework on the computer.
I watch TV in the evening.
I listen to the radio in the morning.

letters.sound: [k] with a strong puff of air
letters.as: English hard c/k, like 'k' in 'kite', usually becomes ㅋ

letters.sound: [ll], the tongue stays up for a moment
letters.as: An English 'l' between vowels, like the 'l' in 'tele' of 'television', becomes ㄹㄹ (텔레). But an 'l' at the end of a syllable, like in 'ball' of 볼펜, is just one final ㄹ. So not every 'l' is ㄹㄹ.
English v is written as ㅂ, so 'video' becomes 비디오. In 텔레비전, the same rule gives 비. The spelling 텔레비젼 is wrong; the correct ending is 전.

exercises: Read out loud and write the English word: ① 라디오 ② 카메라 ③ 컵
Choose the correct spelling: ① cup (컵 / 겁) ② ballpoint pen (볼펜 / 보펜) ③ video (피디오 / 비디오)
Choose the correct spelling for the sentence: ① 집에 (텔레비젼 / 텔레비전)이 없어요. ② (카메라 / 가메라)로 사진을 찍어요. ③ (컴퓨타 / 컴퓨터)가 느려요.
Which object do you use? Answer with one word from this sheet: ① 사진을 찍는 기계예요. ② 종이에 이름을 써요. ③ 여기에 물을 따라서 마셔요.
answers: ① radio ② camera ③ cup
① 컵 ② 볼펜 ③ 비디오
① 텔레비전 ② 카메라 ③ 컴퓨터
① 카메라 ② 볼펜 ③ 컵
